title: Failure Leakage Analysis — Certified Pool Pre-Flight Defect Detection

executive_summary.v1_problem: 89.5% of items (1,987 of 2,221) reached certification boards with unresolved defects. No pre-flight screening existed. Defects were discovered reactively by board reviewers, creating rework loops (2.5:1 duplicate review ratio) and session bloat (9+ reports per session on average).
executive_summary.v2_solution: Readiness Engine pre-screens every item through 5 gates (Neg1 through Gate 4) before any board sees it. Only READY and MINOR_FIX items reach Quality/Certification boards. REMEDIATE and BLOCKED items are invisible to those boards and must be remediated first.
executive_summary.v2_result_hard_defects: 0 items with structural or correctness defects reach certification boards. 100% elimination of hard-defect leakage.
executive_summary.v2_result_soft_defects: 550 items (24.8% of certified pool) reach certification boards with pedagogical warnings (MINOR_FIX). These can be certified with acknowledged warnings and do not pose learner-safety risks.
executive_summary.overall_leakage_reduction: 89.5% → 24.8% (71.4% improvement). Hard-defect goal (<10%) met at 0.0%. Overall goal (<10%) requires resolving DL-031 difficulty inflation (~410 items) and EV3 citation gaps (~140 items).

qids_that_would_pass_preflight_with_warn.description: Items that pass Gate 1/Gate 3/Gate 4 but fail Gate 2 SOFT_FAIL → MINOR_FIX. Visible to all boards. Certifiable with acknowledged warnings.

dl031_difficulty_inflation.note: These items test Bloom's Remember/Understand — the candidate matches a textbook definition to the correct term. No application, analysis, or evaluation is required. Labeled Moderate (3), should be Easy (1).
dl031_difficulty_inflation.qid_pattern: Systematic across all packs. Items where stem-keyword-to-CorrectChoice lexical overlap exceeds 50%. Not a per-section artifact — template-rotation authoring pipeline assigned difficulty labels by position rather than cognitive demand.
dl031_difficulty_inflation.remediation_action: Recalibrate Difficulty: Moderate→Easy, DifficultyScore: 3→1. Verify Bloom's level alignment (should be Remember or Understand). Per-item verification required — not all Moderate items with high lexical overlap are definition-match items.

estimated_distribution.note: Pack E tends to understate difficulty rather than overstate. Negative count indicates Pack E items below expectation — may need upward calibration.

ev3_missing_citations.defect_class: EV3 (missing governing standard citation in ExplanationCorrect)
ev3_missing_citations.note: Per CAQS §4.1, every correct-answer explanation must name the governing principle by name (ASC, COSO, IAS, IMA standard). Items at Remember/Understand level are exempted from this requirement for definition-type questions.
ev3_missing_citations.remediation_action: Add ASC/COSO/IAS references to ExplanationCorrect fields. Verify citation matches the item's topic (avoid DL-009 incorrect-citation pattern).

estimated_distribution.note: Pack E Section C has highest EV3 weakness density (30% of sampled items). Pack B has authoritative pipeline with consistent standard citations.

qids_already_clean.note: These items are immediately certifiable under v2. No structural defects, no pedagogical flags, no metadata warnings. The readiness engine would present them to certification boards with CERTIFIABLE flag.

board_visibility_rule_impact.description: How the readiness engine's board visibility rules (§board_visibility_rules) eliminate failure leakage.

rule_effectiveness.BLOCKED_hidden_from_all_facing_boards: 0 items currently BLOCKED. Mechanism: Gate -1 (identity) and Gate 0 (JSON integrity) catch items before any board sees them. Items without parseable QIDs or with JSON corruption never enter any pipeline.
rule_effectiveness.REMEDIATE_hidden_from_quality_certificat: 70 items hidden (3.2% of certified pool). Mechanism: Gate 1 HARD_FAIL → REMEDIATE → invisible to Quality and Certification boards. Remediation required before board review. Governance board maintains full inventory for tracking.
rule_effectiveness.MINOR_FIX_visible_with_warnings: 550 items visible with warning badges. Mechanism: Gate 2 SOFT_FAIL → MINOR_FIX → visible but flagged. Board reviewers see warning badges listing specific SOFT_FAIL reasons. Can certify with acknowledged warnings.

remediation_required_before_recertificat.description: Under v2, items currently Certified would need remediation before re-certification if they fall into REMEDIATE classification.
remediation_required_before_recertificat.warning_impact: MINOR_FIX items retain certification but display warning badges in board views. Certification can proceed with acknowledged warnings per spec §certification_board.display_as.
remediation_required_before_recertificat.note: v2 is backward-compatible — Certified items do not lose Certified status. They gain readiness classifications that inform future re-certification waves. Only items explicitly re-submitted to certification board would be affected by visibility rules.

certification_board_queue_reduction.note: 3.2% reduction sounds small but represents elimination of ALL learner-safety-critical defects from certification workflow. The 70 hidden items are precisely those with structural defects that could mis-educate learners.

count_staleness_risk.issue: DL-008 count of 67 sourced from SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24.md. SESSION_STATUS is known stale (reports 2,031 Certified vs actual 2,221). Actual DL-008 count may differ.
count_staleness_risk.mitigation: Run boundary-aware within-object DL-008 scan (Function constructor parse per-item) on all 5 packs. This session is shadow-mode (read-only) — full scan deferred to readiness engine implementation.

dl016_false_positive_risk.issue: DL-016 (metadata-content Choice mismatch) causes forward-scan CC extraction errors on Pack C/D dual-block items. Items flagged as DL-008 may actually only have DL-016 MODERATE (metadata shift, learner-facing content correct).
dl016_false_positive_risk.mitigation: Per SPEC §certification-blocking conditions (QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.4.2): use within-object CorrectChoice extraction, not forward-scan. Agent 5 (Pack D Section C) methodology from Session 506/507 is the reference pattern.

dl026_undercount_risk.issue: DL-026 count of 3 in certified pool sourced from enforced-depth spot-checks (2026-07-23). Scanning tool false positives from DL-016 may have inflated prior counts; conversely, additional DL-026 items may have been missed.
dl026_undercount_risk.mitigation: Full boundary-aware object-level DL-026 scan on certified items. Per-item: extract CC → check all 3 non-CC EW slots for emptiness.

mid_session_drift.issue: Per spec §mid_session_drift_check, any item whose classification changes between T0 and Tmid (e.g., new DL-008 discovered on previously-clean item) triggers pipeline halt.
mid_session_drift.pipeline_impact: Low for this shadow-mode session (read-only). For production readiness engine: 67 DL-008 items in certified pool creates moderate risk of count change during long remediation sessions.

difficulty_distribution.deviation: Moderate overrepresented (48.2% vs 30% target). Easy underrepresented (22.4% vs 15% target — but includes DL-031 inflated items). Difficult severely underrepresented (4.4% vs 25% target).

correctchoice_distribution.assessment: Within acceptable range (22-28% per CAQS §6.5). Slight B-bias (26.7%) — consistent with template rotation artifact (5-item groups generate 20% A, 20% B, 20% C, 20% D, 20% A for 6th item). Long-term rebalancing recommended.

appendix_current_state_verified.verification_method: Direct file grep (Select-String) on all 5 pack files, cross-checked against documented defect manifests and prior session reports.
